Package com.signalwire.sdk.relay

Class Constants

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.relay.Constants
public final class Constants extends Object
Constants for the SignalWire RELAY protocol.

Includes call states, end reasons, message states, event types, and action terminal states used throughout the RELAY client.
